mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a range of issues concerning the relationship between domestic and external policy, sovereignty and adequacy of agreements and arrangements at bilateral, regional, international or global level."

A convention is an agreement creating binding obligations between subjects of international law.

Two prominent international courts are the International Court of Justice (ICJ) also known as World Court and the International Criminal Court.

Diplomacy is the management of relations between sovereign states and other international actors.

Perhaps even more important is the question of the relationships of neutrality to collective security.

An accession or adhesion is the declaration of a state's intent to be bound by a treaty it had not signed.
